headline.purpose: Block H2s. Always states, never asks.

headline-compact.purpose: A block headline in a narrow column beside an artifact. Headline at full size ran to six lines there and swamped the artifact it described.

body.purpose: Two sentences maximum per block, measure capped at 65 characters.

figure-hero.purpose: Exactly one per page — the number the whole page argues toward. Must be larger than the H1 or the reveal it exists for does not fire.

figure-sum.purpose: A total that adds up the Data figures above it. One step larger than its parts, always smaller than Figure Hero, so the page keeps exactly one biggest number.

data.purpose: Extracted figures — audit percentages, proof counts, the price. Set at display weight because a number is a headline here.

control.purpose: Button labels and input text. The one step between Label and Body, because a control is neither a caption nor prose.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, badges, chips, table headers, flow-strip nodes.

annotation.purpose: Rare handwritten aside in Caveat. Never load-bearing.

shadows.name: artifact-lift
shadows.purpose: Mockups depicting a real external object (Slack message, sample audit). The only content elevation permitted.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Focus and active states on green interactive elements.

shadows.name: ambient-field
shadows.purpose: Atmospheric property of the background night field, never of a content block.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transition on interactive elements.

motion.name: ease-quick
motion.purpose: Input focus and small color shifts.

motion.name: ease-atmospheric
motion.purpose: Background field, blur, and reveal transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action in view. Highest-contrast pairing in the system.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88 0%, #00d4ff 50%, #0066ff 100%); color: #020617; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00ff88; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA, e.g. 'See a sample Integrity Audit'. Stroke and label both go green on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 28px; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #00ff88; color: #00ff88; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00ff88; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Eyebrow or delivery-promise marker beside a CTA. Green because it states a commitment the system keeps.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.3); color: #00ff88; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 50px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Scannable set member — flag categories, integration names. Replaces bulleted lists that were four lines of reading.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04); color: #94a3b8; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 50px; transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #f1f5f9; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Demo-modal field. Stroke goes green with a signal glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #0f172a; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 12px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #00ff88; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Transparent at rest, night-void glass with a hairline border once scrolled. Only the demo CTA is a button.
components.html: What You GetPricingBook a Demo
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 40px; background: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); padding: 16px 24px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { color: #94a3b8; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f1f5f9; } .ds-nav-cta { margin-left: auto; background: #00ff88; color: #020617; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 12px; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #00cc6a; }

components.name: Flow Strip
components.description: Signature. Horizontal sequence of label nodes joined by arrows, set directly on the night field with no container. Exists so a visitor who reads nothing else still knows what the product does.
components.html: Call ends→We read it→CRM updated, team alerted→Monthly report
components.css: .ds-flow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-flow-node { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-flow-node.is-terminal { color: #00ff88; } .ds-flow-arrow { color: #334155; font-size: 0.85rem; }

components.name: Big-Number Row
components.description: Signature. Extracted figures set at display weight with label captions, on a shared baseline, no dividers. One member may be a non-numeric finding in the same weight — the asymmetry is the argument.
components.html:
1,020calls read
1,322objections captured in the buyer's own words
425risky promises flagged
components.css: .ds-numbers { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 48px; font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-number { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 220px; } .ds-number-value { color: #00ff88; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-number-caption { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Artifact Surface
components.description: The only bounded surface in the system. Depicts an object that exists elsewhere — a Slack alert, a CRM record, an audit page — and takes real elevation so it reads as pasted onto the page rather than composed into it.
components.html:
CloserMetrix · APP · 2:47 PM
Flag on today's call — Discovery Call, 34:12
Rep said: “Honestly most of our guys make it back in the first sixty days.”
components.css: .ds-artifact { background: #1e293b; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 25px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); font-family: Inter, -apple-system, sans-serif; max-width: 480px; } .ds-artifact-meta { color: #64748b; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-artifact-flag { color: #ef4444; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-artifact-body { color: #f1f5f9; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview:
Something is awake while the team sleeps. The field is a deep, unlit night sky and almost all of it stays empty — the page is not decorated, it is watched. Aurora light does not wash over the composition; it appears in the specific places where the system found something, the way a monitoring surface only lights up when there is something to report. The atmosphere is calm and slightly cold, never anxious, because the product's promise is that the watching already happened and nothing was missed.

Structurally the system is flat and ruled. Content sits directly on the night field, separated by hairline rules and shifts in background tone rather than by cards, borders, and shadows. This is deliberate: the page has to carry six different block shapes in ten blocks — a comparison table, a split quote composition, a Slack mockup, a big-number row, a timeline, a checklist — and card containers would flatten all six into the same rectangle. The absence of chrome is what lets the shapes be legible as shapes.

The confirmed anti-reference is the site's own previous build: a gradient headline over two paragraphs of grey body copy, centered, ten times in a row. Nothing varied, so the eye never landed and the page read as an essay with headers. Icons were everywhere and read as decoration. Both are now prohibited. Anywhere the old page would have reached for an icon, this system reaches for the product's actual output.
keyCharacteristics: Near-empty night field; content is sparse and the emptiness is load-bearing
Aurora accent as signal, never as surface treatment
Flat and ruled — no cards, no content shadows
Layout shape varies block to block; no two adjacent blocks share a composition
Type does the hierarchy work; there are no icons anywhere
Motion is atmospheric and slow, never announcing itself

rules.name: The Finding Rule
rules.body: Aurora Green only ever marks something the system found or something the visitor should do. A number the product extracted, a flag, a quoted buyer phrase, the primary CTA. It never becomes a border, a background wash, a decorative rule, or an accent on copy that makes no claim. Audit test: point at any green pixel and name the finding it represents. If you cannot, remove it.

rules.name: The Four Gradient Rule
rules.body: The aurora gradient appears on at most four moments per page — the hero, the depth block, the 24-hour promise, and the price reveal. When every headline is gradient, none of them are emphasized.

rules.name: The Muted Floor Rule
rules.body: Slate Dim (#64748b) is banned as a text color at any size — it measures 3.9:1 against Night Void. Body copy uses Paper; secondary prose, captions, and legal small type bottom out at Ash (#94a3b8, 6.9:1). Grey-on-near-black was a real legibility defect on the previous build, not a style.

rules.name: The Two Sentence Rule
rules.body: No block carries more than two sentences of body copy. A block that needs a third needed a picture instead. This is a hard structural constraint, not a preference.

rules.name: The Display Line
rules.body: Archivo stops at the figure. Headings (h1–h6), Data and Figure Hero get it; body, labels, chips, nav, and every UI control stay Inter. A page where both faces appear at the same size has lost the distinction that justifies the second file.

rules.name: The One Figure Rule
rules.body: Exactly one Figure Hero per page — the number the whole page argues toward, larger than the H1. On the homepage that is $3. A second one means neither is the point.

rules.name: The Number Is A Headline Rule
rules.body: Extracted figures are set in Data, not in body copy with bold. '1,020 calls read' is a headline that happens to be numeric.

rules.name: The Emptiness Rule
rules.body: The hero carries no dashboard image and no illustration. Space around a claim is what makes the claim legible; do not fill a quiet region because it looks unfinished.

rules.name: The No Card Rule
rules.body: Content blocks have no container. If a block feels like it needs a card to hold together, its layout is wrong — change the shape, don't add a box.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing glows until it is hovered, focused, or is itself a flag. Glow is a response, not a finish.

dos: Do make every green pixel name a finding or an action. Aurora Green stays under ~10% of any viewport.
Do cap body copy at two sentences per block and measure at ~65 characters.
Do vary the composition every block; six distinct shapes across a ten-block page, no two adjacent alike.
Do separate with hairline rules (1px, Night Light) and tonal steps, not with cards.
Do set extracted figures in Data type at display weight — a number is a headline here.
Do give artifact mockups real elevation so they read as objects lifted from somewhere real.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion; the aurora field, blur, and scroll effects must all have a still state.
donts: Don't use icons as decoration, as section ornament, or as a stand-in for evidence. The one carve-out is a mark that performs a function no type can: the pricing checklist's check, which confirms a delivered output rather than labelling a topic. If a glyph could be deleted without losing information, it was decoration.
Don't put a gradient on more than four moments per page.
Don't set any text in Slate Dim (#64748b) — it fails contrast at every size on the night field.
Don't wrap content in cards, and don't add a shadow to anything that isn't an artifact, a focus state, or a flag.
Don't center-stack more than two consecutive blocks.
Don't hardcode a hex. Every value in this file exists as a CSS custom property in src/styles/index.css.
Don't build a competitor comparison column, table, or cost-versus-X block — the position is different, not better.
Don't name a regulator, and don't invent a finding, quote, testimonial, logo, or metric inside a visual. This product sells evidence.
